name: Kemonomichi -Hachi-
source:
The magic soldier from before gathered 3 companions. 
However one of the companions has an unusual bodily power. 
That power toys with the "red witch of lightning". 
Discovering this, that princess also has a secret maneuver... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE158225.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
之前的魔兵召集了三个同伴。
然而，其中一位同伴拥有不寻常的身体力量。
那股力量玩弄着“闪电之红魔女”。
发现这一点，那位公主还有一个秘技…… 

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE158225.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
